shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "-----" && find .agents -type f | head -50 && echo "-----" && cat AGENTS.md && echo "-----" && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null

find src -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "=== {}"; cat {}' && echo "=== index.html" && cat index.html && cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore && echo "=== routing head" && sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo "=== traps" && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo "=== installed version" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ 2>/dev/null; grep -n -i -A3 "required setup\|## Install\|## Usage" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -60

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Avatar TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Button Text Flex Box Card Divider Icon spacing 2>&1 | head -80; echo "=== icons"; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/*.js 2>/dev/null | wc -l; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -i -E "^(ArrowUpFromLine|Camera|Picture|Person|TrashBin|Xmark|Upload|CloudArrowUpIn)\b" ; echo "=== i18n"; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Avatar TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Button Text Flex Box Card Divider Icon spacing 2>&1 | head -80

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && for f in Avatar/Avatar.d.ts Avatar/types.d.ts controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts controls/types.d.ts Select/types.d.ts Switch/Switch.d.ts Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts Button/Button.d.ts Text/Text.d.ts layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts layout/Box/Box.d.ts Card/Card.d.ts Divider/Divider.d.ts; do echo "=== $f"; sed -n 1,140p "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^\s*$" | head -120; done; echo "=== layout exports"; ls layout; cat layout/spacing/spacing.d.ts 2>/dev/null; sed -n 1,60p layout/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null

ls Avatar/types; cat Avatar/types/*.d.ts; echo "=== ControlProps"; grep -n -A 40 "interface ControlProps" types.d.ts; grep -n -B2 -A 12 "ControlGroupOption" types.d.ts | head -40; echo "=== Button views"; cat Button/constants.d.ts; echo "=== Text"; cat Text/text/text.d.ts | head -60; cat Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -30; echo "=== Label"; sed -n 1,40p Label/Label.d.ts; echo "=== index exports"; grep -o "export \* from \"./[A-Za-z]*" index.d.ts | sed 's/.*\.\///' | tr '\n' ' '

cat Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts Avatar/AvatarIcon/types.d.ts Avatar/AvatarText/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null || ls Avatar/AvatarImage Avatar/AvatarIcon; echo "=== toaster"; ls Toaster; grep -n "useToaster\|export" Toaster/index.d.ts; grep -n -A6 "interface ToastProps" Toaster/types.d.ts | head -40; echo "=== Icon"; sed -n 1,30p Icon/Icon.d.ts; echo "=== Alert"; grep -n "theme\|title\|message\|view" Alert/types.d.ts | head -20

cat Toaster/Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts; sed -n 1,20p Toaster/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.d.ts; grep -n -B2 -A14 "interface ToastProps" Toaster/types.d.ts; grep -n "add\|remove" Toaster/types.d.ts | head; sed -n 1,30p layout/Container/Container.d.ts | grep -n "maxWidth\|gutters\|spaceRow"
sed -n 1,31p Toaster/types.d.ts; grep -n "constructor\|new Toaster\|class Toaster" Toaster/Toaster.d.ts

sed -i 's/  Icon,\n  Select,/&/; s/^  Icon,$/  Icon,\n  spacing,/; s/className="g-s__mt_1"/className={spacing({mt: 1})}/' src/ProfileSettingsPage.tsx && grep -n "spacing" src/ProfileSettingsPage.tsx && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -25
